## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Architecture Alignment

How does this feature align with the Runtime Shell Architecture (v3.0.7)?

| Aspect | Impact |
|--------|--------|
| Layer | Which layer does this affect? (Plugin/Capability/Host/Infrastructure) |
| Capability | Does this require a new capability contract? |
| Breaking Change | Will this break existing APIs? |

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

Describe specific use cases where this feature would be beneficial:

1. **Use Case 1**: Description
2. **Use Case 2**: Description

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, share them here.

```typescript
// Example code or API design
interface ProposedCapability {
  method(): void;
}
```

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] I have read the Architecture Blueprint
- [ ] This feature aligns with Brix design principles
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature (optional)
